name: Synn
message: 「Oh, Paqy. Could you get that for a sec?」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmm... delicious! With this, this week's meals are--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Synn-sama. It's a call from an angel, though...」

name: Paqy
message: 「You oughta just head outside and see.」
Still holding her phone, Lolotte fell right onto her butt.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Just in case, I thought I'd ask if it was alright before coming over.」
What was she planning to do if I hadn't been home?

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you for taking care of me yesterday.」

name: Synn
message: 「So... since you came by today, does that mean?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. I was wondering if you might study together with me again~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sorry for barging in like a self-invited wife.」

name: Synn
message: 「...!? This is truly a flower on each arm!」
Wait, no, no. The two of them only came over to study.

name: Amyrina
message: 「To be compared to something pretty, what an honor~」
Phew, looks like I managed to brush it off somehow.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Of course! I love it just as much as hamburg steak.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, we had curry and rice yesterday too, didn't we.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Oh... so that delicious food was curry and rice.」
Man, watching these two interact really warms the heart...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, I'm super curious about the President's homemade curry and rice too~~」

name: Synn
message: 「If you'd like... want to stay for lunch?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「How wonderful for you, Lolotte. To be able to eat your favorite food again.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ahh, I'm so happy I feel like I'm going to forget all about the test.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wahaha. Lunch is still a long way off, after all.」
While the two of us sat facing each other and studying for a while, I noticed something a little off.

name: Synn
message: 「Amyrina... um... Do you have a test?」
The Young Girl was quietly watching us from beside Lolotte.
Amyrina wore the kind of expression someone makes when told that wood ear mushrooms are actually fungi.

name: Lolotte
message: 「You see, a test is a trial for students to demonstrate the results of their daily efforts~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, once we overcome this test, our happy everyday life will return~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Wait, even Amyrina doesn't need to study, does she?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you saying, President? Better safe than sorry, you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Actually, I've been inviting Amyrina to come to school as well.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We'll attend school together. And commute to and from school together.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then we'll be in the same class, study together, eat lunch together--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Participate in Student Council activities with us... and spend a sparkling school life together♪ Don't you think that's a great idea?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. It'd be wonderful if we could do that.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Huh!? N-No, no, it's nothing like that!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's quite alright. I'm sure things like that will get neatly resolved through what they call 'adult circumstances.'」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, to commemorate our study session together, I present you with one of my treasured college-ruled notebooks!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey. Are you sure you wanna throw away your precious personal assets like that?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. I got tons of them from a recycling drive.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He's the Student Council President I'm so proud of.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Awawawa! Oh no! I don't have any time to spare anymore!\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「It's almost lunchtime, so let's keep at it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But the spiciness doesn't linger, so it's super delicious~~\s07」

name: Amyrina
message: 「It has a very creeeamy flavor, doesn't it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So this is the curry rice from Mr. President's house.」

name: Synn
message: 「I put extra milk in it today. If it's too spicy, just drink it normally.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, geez. You got it all around your mouth.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whenever there is something you don't understand, open the guidebook right away~」

name: Amyrina
message: 「A new life born from a family nurturing love, is it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. And that I am just like a baby--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wait, Mr. President! What is that supposed to mean?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, getting someone to wipe your mouth for you... you know.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I simply got a little carried away. Normally, I display splendid table manners.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「However, that is too stiff, so you cannot enjoy the food, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, take your time and don't rush.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「U-Um... well... m-may I... ask for some too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Both of you at the same time? Make sure you chew your food properly, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Man, those two sure get along well~」

name: Paqy
message: 「You think so? To the great me, it looks like the Demon Lord and the angel are way closer, y'know?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, we're fellow members of the Student Council, so.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You guys sure get touchy-feely for just that. Could you do the same thing with Hisu or Soba?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's... H-How do I put it, I just can't leave Lolotte alone, or rather...\s03 I mean, I'm her upperclassman, after all!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is Ria-chan letting you do that kind of stuff to her!? If she is, I ain't letting you live!!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Could it be that there weren't any seconds left?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, it's not that, it's just...」
Ugh~~ Because Paqy said weird stuff, now I'm feeling weirdly self-conscious...

name: Amyrina
message: 「I give thanks for our daily meals.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Of course it is! He is the President I'm so proud of, after all!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Oh, Lolotte, that's all you've been saying for a while now.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm going to follow the President's example closely and become a splendid bride myself.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Look, look, you've got tons of curry on your mouth too, Mr. President.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is payback for earlier, you know~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Could it be that you want me to do it for you too, Amyrina?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Amyrina is a big eater, after all~~」

name: Amyrina
message: 「I don't want to hear that from you, Lolotte!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Phew~~ My tummy is full and my heart is full of happiness~~」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Hehehe. You always fall right asleep as soon as your stomach is full, don't you, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll be fine! Today Mr. President is right here with me, after all!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then let's go into the futon together, yes indeed.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, it's the final stretch. Let's do our best!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「The reason Lolotte... can always keep smiling...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「At this rate... Lolotte will... I have to do something...」
